description.default: Dictate into SiYuan with your own transcription API (any /audio/transcriptions endpoint, e.g. Whisper-compatible services) or browser speech recognition. Review and edit the text in a preview, add more dictation, and insert it exactly where your cursor was.
description.en_US: Dictate into SiYuan with your own transcription API (any /audio/transcriptions endpoint, e.g. Whisper-compatible services) or browser speech recognition. Review and edit the text in a preview, add more dictation, and insert it exactly where your cursor was.
description.de_DE: Diktiere in SiYuan mit deiner eigenen Transkriptions-API (jeder /audio/transcriptions-Endpunkt, z. B. Whisper-kompatible Dienste) oder der Spracherkennung des Browsers. Prüfe und bearbeite den Text in einer Vorschau, diktiere weiter und füge ihn genau an der ursprünglichen Cursorposition ein.
description.zh_CN: 使用你自己的转写 API（任何提供 /audio/transcriptions 端点的服务，例如兼容 Whisper 的服务）或浏览器语音识别在思源中听写。可在预览中检查和编辑文字、继续追加听写，并准确插入到原来的光标位置。
